Documented installation, configuration, development, build, test, CLI, MCP and operational workflows in the root README.
Documented package integration through the Core, CLI, MCP stdio server and Astro, Eleventy and Next.js adapters.

Completed the user-requested single-manual documentation scope and prepared the authorized documentation and specification changes for publication.
